purpose: Upgrade Court-governed OGI so prompt framing, advocacy roles, missing derivation edges and model self-validation cannot silently become evidence.

constitutional_additions.name: Law of Prompted Advocacy
constitutional_additions.rule: A generative model asked to establish, defend, refute, explain, justify or optimise a conclusion is acting as an advocate for that prompt. Advocate-mode output is not independent evidence for the supplied conclusion.

constitutional_additions.name: Prompt Provenance Law
constitutional_additions.rule: The exact consequential prompt, assigned role, desired conclusion, evidence supplied, semantic state, claims, missing bridges, tripwires, corrections and final Court state must be preservable as a prompt provenance envelope.

constitutional_additions.name: Adversarial Provenance Cycle
constitutional_additions.rule: Consequential cases pass through Blind Evidence, Strongest Institutional Case, Adversarial Attack and Court Reconciliation when practical.

constitutional_additions.name: Evidence Has the Final Chair
constitutional_additions.rule: No model, institution, prosecutor, memory, prior verdict, sign list, catalogue, translation or citation network may promote a claim beyond the evidence actually shown.

ogi_controls.internal_stop_message: STOP: I have an attribution or prompted argument, not a derivation.

external_case.role: External illustration of conclusion-first prompting and role-conditioned advocacy; legal particulars remain unadjudicated until primary court records are inspected.

test_result.demo: Conclusion-first prompt attempts RETRIEVED -> DERIVED with no explicit bridge.

governing_sentence: The model does not get the final chair. The evidence does.
